paragraphs: Of the 133 registrants, 74 attended (55.6% attendance), yielding 31 post‑event engaged contacts, of which 12 became MQL+ and 9 progressed to SQL+ (16.2% attendee‑to‑MQL conversion). The webinar engaged 5 buying‑committee accounts. The top‑scoring accounts were Palmetto SaaS Group (9 engaged contacts, 90% committee coverage), Anchorpoint SaaS (7 engaged contacts, 87.5% coverage) and Truenorth Ecommerce (4 engaged contacts, 100% coverage).

Anomaly detection shows two compressed research sprints: 21 of 26 touches (80.8%) for an unspecified contact at an unspecified company occurred on 2026-08-07 with no lifecycle movement, signaling a stalled hot lead that warrants a manual RevOps review; and 17 of 27 touches (63.0%) for another unspecified contact/company on 2026-07-25, where the lifecycle stage already reflects the activity, suggesting no further action is needed.
